// === FILE: Proteus.8.9/installation guide.txt ===
﻿Installation

1. Install P8.9.sp0.exe
2. Choose Custom install

3. Set paths：

for Windows 32
	Installation Path - C:\Program Files\Labcenter Electronics\Proteus 8 Professional\
	Program Data Path - C:\Program Files\Labcenter Electronics\Proteus 8 Professional\

for Windows 64
	Installation Path - C:\Program Files (x86)\Labcenter Electronics\Proteus 8 Professional\
	Program Data Path - C:\Program Files (x86)\Labcenter Electronics\Proteus 8 Professional\


4. After installing Proteus do not start!

5. Unzip patch.zip to the directory with Proteus installed.

6. In the same place (in the Proteus directory) run PP8.9.EXE

7.If necessary, use LICENCE.EXE to add a license file (as practice has shown, if you still have a license from 8.8, you can work with it)

8. All is ready.

	Installation Path - C:\Program Files (x86)\Labcenter Electronics\Proteus 8 Professional\
